channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cam Johnson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cam Johnson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bryce Hopkins on Cam Johnson
item.description:
Bryce Hopkins:

“I probably say Cam Johnson the most. I was just asking him questions, picking his mind on, you know, just how was it when he first came into the league,what was he expecting, and how his overall first year went for him.”

Bryce Hopkins on Cam Johnson, Oct 4, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on Cam Johnson, Christian Braun
item.description:
David Adelman on Christian Braun, who is doubtful to play tonight:

“I don’t think he’ll play…just want to make sure that his explosion - his comfort level is where it should be. Cam Johnson is the same way.”

David Adelman on Cam Johnson, Christian Braun, Feb 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson remaining with the Nets through the trade deadline:

“He’s the type of person that you want around, that you want in your family... All that speculation came from the outside. We obviously value Cam Johnson, and we want him here.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson, Feb 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson's return:

“It's always great to have him...for obvious reasons. Leadership in the right way. He creates attention. He makes everyone's life easier; not just his teammates but also me. So it's great to have him, great connector, great leader.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Johnson, Feb 5, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Cam Johnson
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on the possibility of Cam Johnson seeing expanded opportunities as a ball handler:

“I think it’s going to be a balance with him. We do need his elite shooting. I think if [there’s] one thing we lean on, we need that. We need the space that he provides for us. Literally, if he can shoot 10 threes a game, I would love that. I’d take him out to dinner every single night. He’s a 40% career 3-point shooter... But at the end of the day, I think he’s growing as a player, and you saw that at the end of the year: His ability to play pick-and-roll, he’s big, he can get downhill, he can play fast. So a lot of good things ahead for him.”

Jacque Vaughn on Cam Johnson, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Mikal Bridges on Cam Johnson
item.description:
“In the summer, KD said he wanted to go to Phoenix so it was kind of in the back of my head ‘cause, you know, we’re not dumb, like, if you want to come here, I was gone and Cam Johnson knew we was,”

Mikal Bridges on Cam Johnson, Jul 25, 2023. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Sean Marks on Cam Johnson
item.description:
Sean Marks on Cam Johnson's free agency:

“I don’t have a crystal ball. I don’t know. I think it’s one of those things that maybe we should expect the unexpected. Things happen all the time in this. We’ll be prepared for that. Cam knows how we feel about him. we hope he's a Net.”

Sean Marks on Cam Johnson, Jun 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.
